ticket: python lint.py (what make lint runs) checks files that the docs build itself skips. Repro: add a third-party folder under docs/, say vendor/ holding the upstream LICENSE.txt, and add "vendor" to exclude_patterns in docs/conf.py. make html leaves it out, as expected. Actual: make lint still reads vendor/LICENSE.txt and reports sphinx-lint errors in it, so the docs lint job fails on a file that is not part of the documentation. Expected: make lint never reports on a file the docs build excludes; it still checks every file the docs build includes, with the same enabled and disabled checks, the 79-character line limit, and any extra arguments passed to lint.py.
